verdict.rationale: The evidence covers checkout, payment tokens, fulfillment webhooks for sellers, and Link CLI reading transaction/balance history, but nothing documents an agent-facing API or tool for querying an order's post-purchase status or shipment tracking (e.g., a 'track my order' capability). Order-related webhooks (checkout.session.completed) and Dashboard filtering are seller-side fulfillment tools, not agent-queryable order/tracking status.
